parameter: ROM-01 HALL REVERB Variation 1 DECAY TIME
promotion_rule: Do not promote to native runtime-ready until research/runtime gates R1-R6 pass together. Release gates L1-L3 are independent and remain mandatory before a playable Force release. Factory audio equivalence is a separate claim and requires an exact original-OS reference comparison.

research_runtime_gates.criteria: Manual domain 0-99 agrees with all 100 OS LCD values; variation, label and selection context are recorded.
research_runtime_gates.evidence: Manual-derived catalog and two complete OS traversals; raw/display matrix covers 100 display values.

research_runtime_gates.criteria: All raw codes 0-127 map to the OS display table; Up/Down transition semantics preserve both codes for every duplicate bucket and match all captured steps.
research_runtime_gates.evidence: 128 raw codes, 100 displays, 28 duplicate buckets, 198/198 transitions and 0 transition mismatches in two full-startup traces.

research_runtime_gates.criteria: GPR 6E/5B/03/04/05 values and order match the OS; event timing or a justified and audio-validated atomic replacement must be proven.
research_runtime_gates.evidence: 198/198 OS groups match values and order. OS writes span multiple DSP frames; runtime API currently queues all five at one frame.

research_runtime_gates.criteria: Runtime traverses all 128 raw states both directions, covering display 0-99 and duplicate routes, against independent raw/display/register expectations; rejects unsupported states and restores its checkpoint.
research_runtime_gates.evidence: Temporary instrumented runtime harness passed 254/254 raw steps and 1270/1270 parameter writes against per-raw values from two OS-derived sweeps using a synthetic package; no authentic-package full-range replay was performed.

research_runtime_gates.criteria: Finite meaningful output is measured across the full range, including duplicate paths, state transitions, endpoints and the chosen event timing; no false no-op claims.
research_runtime_gates.evidence: A 40/41 native A/B has measurable difference; full range and intermediate-frame behavior have not been tested.

research_runtime_gates.criteria: At least two independent clean OS boots reproduce the raw/display table, every transition, ordered register values and timing; record boot provenance.
research_runtime_gates.evidence: Two full original-OS emulator sweeps were captured under caller-recorded distinct CLI PIDs 154605 and 154697. Their complete 200-step event and step arrays match exactly, including 198 ordered register groups and cycle/frame stamps; independent matrix comparison reports zero mismatches. Emulator, not physical silicon.

release_gates.criteria: Native parameter identity and saved host chunk remain compatible across the candidate upgrade; no stale control overwrites the stepper raw state.
release_gates.evidence: Stepper is not integrated into the stable 19-route VST parameter registry.

release_gates.criteria: Fresh ARMv7 hard-float build, ABI/link/dependency checks and runtime tests for the integrated candidate.
release_gates.evidence: No ARMv7 build of this new API integration was performed.

release_gates.criteria: Physical Force host delivers the intended control event and wet audio remains correct across effect changes and save/reload.
release_gates.evidence: No device test or installation performed.

separate_claim_gates.criteria: Exact numerical or explicitly tolerance-bounded comparison against matching original-OS audio with identical stimulus, state, timing, routing and alignment.
separate_claim_gates.evidence: The 40/41 difference test proves response only; it is not an OS-reference comparison.

blocking_items: R3 runtime event timing differs from OS timing and has no intermediate-state audio validation
R5 lacks full-range audio behavior evidence
known_robustness_defect: Non-finite VST input remains an open tracked issue and is not waived by this parameter validation.
